component.name: PaintingCredit
component.script:
sub init() th = LumenTheme() m.name = m.top.createChild("Label") m.name.font = LumenFont("Fraunces-Italic", 30) m.name.color = th.white m.name.horizAlign = "right" m.name.width = 1200 m.name.translation = [1824 - 1200, 944] m.credit = m.top.createChild("Label") m.credit.font = LumenFont("Manrope-ExtraBold", 18) m.credit.color = WithAlpha(th.white, 0.78) m.credit.horizAlign = "right" m.credit.width = 1200 m.credit.translation = [1824 - 1200, 986] onTheme() end sub
sub onTheme() t = LumenTheme().themes[m.top.theme] if t = invalid then return m.name.text = t.painting m.credit.text = "AFTER VINCENT VAN GOGH · PAINTED FOR " + UCase(t.weather) end sub
